items.title: Trent Q1 Results: Profit rises 21% YoY to Rs 519 crore; revenue up 18%
items.description: Trent Q1 Results: Trent reported a 21% year-on-year rise in Q1 consolidated net profit to Rs 519 crore, while revenue grew 18% to Rs 5,755 crore. The retailer expanded its store network to over 1,300 outlets across 330 cities, opening 23 stores during the quarter. It expects the pace of new store additions to remain broadly consistent over the coming year.

items.title: Deccan Gold Mines shares rally 13% after maiden gold doré production at Altyn Tor Project
items.description: Deccan Gold Mines shares surged over 13% after the company announced the production of its first gold doré at the Altyn Tor Gold Project in Kyrgyzstan. The milestone validates the upgraded processing circuit and de-risks the project ahead of commercial production.
